title: Work order log entries read as designed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide with the zoom at 100%, and the design pictures "card-18-b-audit.png" (board 1.18) and "card-19-n1-audit.png" (board 1.19) attached to this case are open beside it at 100% (actual size). Names, numbers and dates in the pictures are sample data.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} is open and not invoiced; it has one approved labor line and one part, and its one "Sales Representative" field reads {Sales-rep-A}.
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001.
  • Starting screen: {Work-order-1} is open in that browser window.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Add the "Sales Representative - Parts" field.
  2. Set "Sales Representative - Parts" to {Sales-rep-B}.
  3. Click the remove x beside "Sales Representative - Parts".
  4. Open the work order's menu.
  5. Click Audit Log and compare the newest entries with the picture of board 1.19.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the card shows "Sales Representative - Labor" and "Sales Representative - Parts".
  • Step 2: Parts reads {Sales-rep-B}.
  • Step 3: the card ends with one "Sales Representative" field reading {Sales-rep-A}.
  • Step 4: the work order's menu opens.
  • Step 5: each change is a "Sales representative changed" entry with who, when and before → after, worded as in the picture, Parts first (for example "{Sales-rep-B} (Parts) · {Sales-rep-A} (Labor) → {Sales-rep-A}").

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11271 (Story 7, Record representative changes in the work order log)

  • S7-R1: “Each change to a work order's representatives, including adding or removing the Parts field, writes one log entry, "Sales representative changed". Adding the Parts field with the same person on both sides is a change and writes one entry, for example "Sales Representative: Ann Able → Ann Able (Parts) · Ann Able (Labor)".”
  • S7-R2: “The entry shows "Sales Representative: {before} → {after}". A work order that is not split reads the one name, or "Unassigned".”
  • S7-R3: “A split work order reads both sides, Parts first: "Devon Whitfield (Parts) · Elliot Brennan (Labor)". An empty side reads "Unassigned", for example "Devon Whitfield (Parts) · Unassigned (Labor)".”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), export read 19 Oct 2026, boards 1.18 Before: the Work Order Log today; 1.19 The log records every rep change (the attached pictures are these boards).

Where the design and the PRD differ: The PRD's Story 7 says "Design: none", yet board 1.19 shows the log; the wording on the board matches the PRD.

Design pictures attached to this case: card-18-b-audit.png, card-19-n1-audit.png.

Clearing: "Daniel Montoya → Unassigned". (Test entries from building this canvas fill the list.)”
  • Design — board 1.18 title: “1.18 Before: the Work Order Log today”
